verdict.rationale: The IRS documents more than one sanctioned intermediary rail. The EIN assistant lets a third-party designee apply with the responsible party's signed authorization (irs-supp-13). The Authorized IRS e-file Provider program has a published enrollment path, suitability checks and fingerprinting, letting credentialed providers transmit via MeF for others (irs-supp-5, irs-supp-6, irs-supp-7). IRIS A2A is gated by a Transmitter Control Code for third-party transmitters (irs-supp-8). Missing for 10: no evidence of a representative or power-of-attorney rail into the Business Tax Account (sign-in is a personal ID.me liveness check), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of these rails working in practice.
